why: Intro to Jupyter plan (docs/ui-next/catalog/plans/intro-jupyter.json), 'Write notes in Markdown cells': the learner wrote everything in one Markdown cell and rendered it: a '# Step tracker' title, two headings written '### The data' and '### Results' (level 3 looked the right size to them) and a '*' bullet list. The plan asks for a title, at least two headings and a bullet list; a level-3 heading is a heading.

step.title: Add a Markdown title, headings and a list
step.instructions: At the top of steps.ipynb, add a cell, press M to make it Markdown and write a # title. Below it, add two headings and a bullet list of what the notebook does, in Markdown cells, then run them (Shift+Enter) so they render.

targets.caption: A Markdown cell with a title

step.code:

## The data

- steps for each day of one week
- a daily goal of 8000
